_comment: Ship Matrix shape (robertsspaceindustries.com/ship-matrix fields). Every number is set against the reference set starcitizenreference/ship_matrix/small_multirole.json (8 flight-ready small multirole / starter ships, median in _reference). Dimensions are measured from the exterior drawing (Tools/Design/draw_ship_design.py prints SHIP_SHEETS) and must stay equal to it. Layout: Design/Wayfarer_layout.json, drawings: Design/*.png, text: Design/Wayfarer_Design.md. Status: 2D design v1 approved by the author on 24. 9. 2026 (all proposed defaults); next: the 3D model.

_reference.closest: Avenger Titan (walk-through hold behind a single cockpit, 8 SCU) and Cutter (bed, rear entry)

identity.name: Wayfarer
identity.description: A lone pilot's first real home among the stars: a single-seat ship you walk into up the rear ramp, with an 8 SCU hold, serviceable components along the corridor, a cabin with a bed and a washroom, and a glass cockpit. Enough guns to defend itself, enough range to wander.

dimensions._note: Length includes the engine nozzles (hull 21.0 m), beam the wingtip cannons, height the tail fins and the deployed gear. Pressure hull 4.6 m wide, interior 3.8 m wide, clear height 2.3 m (cockpit floor 0.35 m higher).

stations: pilot (flies, fires the wing guns and missiles, runs power / shields / quantum from the side consoles)

flight._note: Design intent, near the reference median; a little heavier and slower than the Aurora, lighter than the Cutter. The game's flight model gets tuned to these in the build step.

propulsion.quantum_drive: 1x S1 (under the hold floor by the ramp)
propulsion.quantum_fuel_tanks: 1x under the hold floor, filler on the belly

thrusters.maneuvering: 8x TR1 (4 around the nose, 2 on each pod)

missiles: 2x S2 racks under the wings, 2 missiles each
utility: handheld tractor beam with charger by the ramp

interior.entry: rear ramp from the ground (22 degrees, hinge at the hold floor), controlled from the left console or mobiGlas - no door keypads
interior.path: ramp -> hold (port aisle 1.25 m) -> technical corridor (2.1 m between components) -> cabin -> step -> cockpit, pilot seat entered from behind
rooms: cabin: bed, suit locker, washroom, food and water
